title: MyProject
subtitle: Consolidated Documentation Set
_notes: Copy this file to your repo root as DOCSET.json and edit it. Paths resolve relative to this file's directory.
landscape:true for wide tables (>~6 columns) — column widths are computed automatically, so it's the only per-doc layout knob.
A 'file' ending in .pdf is a pre-rendered leaf: a section cover is prepended and the PDF concatenated as-is.
A 'file' may use '../' to reach a doc outside docs_dir. Any key starting with '_' is ignored by the engine.
Build with:  python <commands>/lib/docset_builder.py DOCSET.json   (or via the /build-docs command).
